meta.description: Display-only synonym groups for keyword clusters. Each group declares one canonical cluster (FK → keyword_lexicon.clusters[].id) and a set of member clusters that should be RENDERED under the canonical's label in segment-tag drawers, charts, and exports. Tagging behavior is unchanged: member clusters keep their own identity in keyword_tags.json, and an analyst can still tag to a member directly. Only the display label / drawer grouping is affected.
changelog: 1.0 — initial groups: cost (8 members), insurance_access (5 members), educational_materials (5 members). Created in response to drawer redundancy surfaced when analyst tried to move a 'prohibitive' tag and saw overlapping Cost / Cost prohibitive / Affordability / Expensive clusters.
notes: Canonical and members are all FK → keyword_lexicon.clusters[].id. Every referenced id must exist in the live lexicon.
A member must share the canonical's parent_subtheme — synonym groups never cross subthemes (use parallel clusters with different parents for that).
The canonical must NOT also be listed in its own members[]. The canonical is implicitly part of the group.
A cluster id may appear in at most one group (no nested or overlapping groups).
If a synonym group has zero members the group should be deleted, not kept.
Renaming: the group's `label` overrides the canonical cluster's label at display time. Leave it null to inherit the cluster.label.
Consumers: SegmentTagDrawer collapses members into the canonical row; chart/report layers that want raw distributions can ignore this file.

group_shape.id: Slug, lowercase + underscores. Globally unique within this file. Often matches canonical, but doesn't have to.
group_shape.canonical: FK → keyword_lexicon.clusters[].id. The cluster whose label is shown.
group_shape.label: Display label override. Use null to inherit cluster.label.
group_shape.description: One sentence describing why these clusters are grouped.
group_shape.members: Array of FK → keyword_lexicon.clusters[].id. Each must share canonical's parent_subtheme.

groups.label: Cost
groups.description: Cost / affordability / price / out-of-pocket framings of treatment as a barrier — all surfaces of the same underlying concept.

groups.label: Insurance & access
groups.description: Insurance plan, coverage, PBMs, prior auth, employer benefits — the system-level access barriers that gate the prescription.
